# Section breaks in lists and tables

The three DOCX inputs are MIT-authored using the local `docx` package. They contain Arial text but no font files. The inputs have Letter pages, 72pt margins, 12pt text, flat decimal/bullet lists or a two-row, two-column table. Their hashes are checked by the tests.

`reference.json` records 44 independent InsertBreak operations in the installed Word baseline: all four section types, list start/middle/end and selected ranges, first/later table rows and a cross-row selection. It includes native selection, text, numbering, tables, sections and page counts, plus hash-bound private original/saved/PDF reports. The six reviewed complete-page sheets cover all 132 reference pages (31 unique exact paper/glyph/pixel identities). These are reference observations, not a passing Noffice compatibility claim. Physical Office keyboard/UI evidence remains unverified.

The native list remains one numbering sequence across sections. An empty section-ending paragraph does not consume a visible number; a following empty item does. A selected range is preserved and the caret collapses after the break. Table insertion moves to the beginning of the selection's row and splits the table only when that row is not the first.

`numbered-independent.docx` and `numbered-continuing.docx` add two MIT-authored inputs, with no embedded fonts. `fresh-reference.json` records eight native middle-of-item section insertions: four section types with two independent lists starting at4/9, and four with one source counter continuing across a plain paragraph. Native insertion, Undo/Redo and reopen preserve the expected text; all eight unique complete pages/24 occurrences were reviewed. `.local/prepare-fresh-list-controls-v1.mjs`, `probe-fresh-list-controls-v1.ps1`, `promote-fresh-list-controls-v1.py` and `review-fresh-list-controls-v1.py` reproduce the controls and bound review. Native keyboard/UI and complete fresh-list authoring remain separate requirements.

`baselines.json` adds four independent original/shaded list controls for regular Arial 12pt Single spacing. Every raw glyph matrix remains unchanged. Five full shaded pages were reviewed; their 22 paragraph/marker offsets span 11.159973–11.183960pt. Source, native executable, PDF report, measurement and review hashes are retained. This profile does not certify other fonts, faces or line rules. `.local/prepare-list-baselines-v1.py`, `probe-list-baselines-v1.ps1`, `compare-list-baselines-v1.py` and `promote-list-baselines-v1.py` reproduce the preparation, native capture, measurement and public evidence.

Reproduction scripts and private outputs: `.local/prepare-word-section-containers-v1.mjs`, `.local/probe-word-section-containers-v1.ps1`, `.local/probe-word-section-containers-v3.ps1`, `.local/review-word-section-containers-v1.py`, and `.local/word-section-containers/`. The failed v2 selection probe is retained separately and is not included in the 44-case oracle. Nested lists, merged tables, tracked changes and clipboard behavior require additional contracts/evidence.
